items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Jimmy Cobb’s on the cymbal. And it was on man. And yeah. That’s what grabbed me.

ctx.x: Well jumping ahead a little bit, apparently you heard “Kind of Blue” played for you by a seventh grade teacher and that was it. Did you— what made the biggest impression on you?

Oh, the biggest impression of that. It grabbed me, Monk. He turned the music on and I listened and what was there — well the first tune was “So What” on the record, was “So What.” And the introduction and the bass, the you know, the free bass line that was there © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
then into the melody and it just — Jimmy Cobb’s on the cymbal. And it was on man. And yeah. That’s what grabbed me. And there’s no other explanation.
